title: Battle of Șelimbăr
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Șelimbăr", at revision 1382085324, opens: "The Battle of Șelimbăr, or Battle of Sellenberk, took place on 18 October 1599 between the Wallachian army of Michael the Brave and the Transylvanian-Hungarian army of Andrew Báthory. The battle was fought near the village of Șelimbăr close to Sibiu." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q592069, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1599 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
